notes: Build84 clean runtime starts from stable Build82. Shipped surface is allowlisted to the canonical launcher, event-driven runtime client, clean account controller and minimal runtime bus only. License activation is reattached directly to ld-license-validate without legacy license-gate, Decrypter Chat DOM takeover or Lovable shell blocking. All other capabilities remain source-preserved and inventory-locked for controlled replacement. No legacy ui/content stack, mount guardian, global MutationObserver, continuous polling, heavy provider engine, OTA metadata or release publication is shipped.
